shots.visual_event: At noon, people cross a busy square but cast no shadows; behind them appear translucent shadows of missing passengers instead.
shots.dialogue_audio: News voice: “Authorities report a citywide optical event.”

shots.visual_event: Meera’s shadow is Arin inside the train; his shadow looks up and meets her gaze independently.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin’s shadow: “Door Seven. She opened it.”

shots.visual_event: Inside Door Seven, Arin and Saira enter a miniature version of the city made from thousands of bottled memories.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Nila moved the debt out of the train.”

shots.visual_event: Nila uncorks a bottle labelled only by editorial text EAST BRIDGE; outside, the real bridge reappears violently through traffic.
Another bottle opens and a living family forgets the child standing between them; Meera pulls the child to safety.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “Returning a place erased a person.”

shots.visual_event: Arin refuses Nila’s offered bottle containing Meera’s complete memory.
shots.dialogue_audio: Arin: “Not if somebody else pays for her.”
